tools.name: sendbird_list_users
tools.description: List the users in the application. Supports filtering by activity, nickname, ids, and metadata. Platform API: GET /users. Returns { users[], next }.

tools.name: sendbird_get_user
tools.description: Fetch a single user by user_id. Platform API: GET /users/{user_id}.

tools.name: sendbird_list_group_channels
tools.description: List group channels in the application, with rich filtering (name, members, distinct/public/super mode). Platform API: GET /group_channels. Returns { channels[], next }.

tools.name: sendbird_get_group_channel
tools.description: Fetch a single group channel by URL, optionally with members and receipts. Platform API: GET /group_channels/{channel_url}.

tools.name: sendbird_list_group_channel_members
tools.description: List the members of a group channel. Platform API: GET /group_channels/{channel_url}/members. Returns { members[], next }.

tools.name: sendbird_list_group_channels_by_user
tools.description: List the group channels a given user belongs to. Platform API: GET /users/{user_id}/my_group_channels. Returns { channels[], next }.

tools.name: sendbird_list_open_channels
tools.description: List open (public, participant-based) channels. Platform API: GET /open_channels. Returns { channels[], next }.

tools.name: sendbird_get_open_channel
tools.description: Fetch a single open channel by URL. Platform API: GET /open_channels/{channel_url}.

tools.name: sendbird_list_messages
tools.description: List messages in a channel, anchored at a timestamp or message id. Provide EITHER message_ts (unix ms) OR message_id. Platform API: GET /{channel_type}/{channel_url}/messages. Returns { messages[] }.

tools.name: sendbird_request
tools.description: Power-user escape hatch: issue a raw GET to any Chat Platform API v3 path not wrapped by a dedicated tool (e.g. /group_channels/{url}/messages/{id}, /report, /applications/settings_global). READ-ONLY — GET only. Platform API: GET {path}.

tools.name: sendbird_send_message
tools.description: MUTATES Sendbird data: sends a message into a channel as a user (MESG) or as an admin (ADMM). File/multipart messages are not supported. Platform API: POST /{channel_type}/{channel_url}/messages.

tools.name: sendbird_create_user
tools.description: MUTATES Sendbird data: creates a new user. Platform API: POST /users.

tools.name: sendbird_update_user
tools.description: MUTATES Sendbird data: partially updates a user's profile. Only provided fields change. Platform API: PUT /users/{user_id}.

tools.name: sendbird_create_group_channel
tools.description: MUTATES Sendbird data: creates a group channel with the given members. Platform API: POST /group_channels.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sendbird_get_group_channel, sendbird_get_open_channel, sendbird_list_messages, sendbird_request · Private data: sendbird_send_message · Public sink: sendbird_send_message, sendbird_create_user, sendbird_create_group_channel.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: sendbird_get_group_channel, sendbird_get_open_channel, sendbird_list_messages, sendbird_request · Private data: sendbird_send_message · Public sink: sendbird_send_message, sendbird_create_user, sendbird_create_group_channel

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
